evidence.note: Flat cream paper colour; no texture, grain, grid or hairline rules anywhere on the slide.
Large dark serif title with a bold green kicker; high contrast and generous size.
Two body lines in mid-grey sans on cream, about 16px at this size; softer contrast than the title but still clearly readable.
Header breadcrumb, Loans pill and Notes button are small but are chrome, legible and not content-bearing.

rationale: The slide has no hairlines, texture or grain, and its paper feel comes from flat colour only. The title is big and high-contrast, and the grey body text stays readable even at the small viewer size, so nothing here would be erased by compression. This matches the pass descriptor.
